name: Low Country Case & Millwork
old_description: At Low Country Case and Millwork, we understand that spaces are more than just physical dimensions – they are canvases waiting to be transformed into unique experiences. As quality craftsman, we specialize in crafting high end designs that breathe life into offices, breweries, hotels, and more turning the customer’s vision into a reality.
about:
Low Country Case & Millwork was founded in 1990 in Ladson, South Carolina, as a family-owned and operated business. The company traces its start to a veterinary clinic project in Summerville for Trident Construction, which remains its largest client. Current CEO David Stasiukaitis is the son of the founder.

The firm provides turnkey architectural millwork and custom cabinetry, handling design, manufacturing, finishing, and installation from its 52,000-square-foot facility. The plant houses four divisions—cabinetry, millwork, finishing, and climate-controlled shipping—and is equipped with CNC machines and Cabinet Vision CAD software. A team of over 60 craftsmen produces plastic laminate cabinets, solid surface counters, wall panels, and high-end woodwork.

The company serves hospitality, medical, office, education, institutional, corporate, and industrial sectors. Notable projects include the Charleston Visitor Center, Hotel Bennett, Firefly Distillery, Sanctuary Chapel at Kiawah, and Roper Medical Office. Trident Construction is cited as a long-standing major client.

Low Country Case & Millwork differentiates itself by controlling quality from drawing through installation, maintaining AWI membership, and emphasizing a “damn good product” philosophy. The founder’s original niche in commercial cabinetry and millwork underpins its turnkey approach.
